content.query:
let GeoIPDB_FULL = _GetWatchlist("geoip");
let MaliciousFlows = NTANetAnalytics
| where SubType == "FlowLog" and FlowType in ("ExternalPublic", "MaliciousFlow")
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, FlowType, IpAddress = SrcIp, DestinationIpAddress = DestIp, DestinationPort = DestPort, Protocol = iff(isempty(L7Protocol), L4Protocol, L7Protocol), NSGRuleMatched = AclRule;
MaliciousFlows
| evaluate ipv4_lookup(GeoIPDB_FULL, IpAddress, network)
| project TimeGenerated, FlowType, IpAddress, DestinationIpAddress, DestinationPort, Protocol, NSGRuleMatched, latitude, longitude, city = cityname, country = countryname, friendly_location = strcat(cityname, " (", countryname, ")")
